title: Read bounded consistent matched fact snapshots for report configurations
description: Customer explicitly chooses a bounded matched-set preview mode for a saved configuration; existing current-page mode remains default. This generic Stage1 contract is prerequisite to real whole-selection summaries/download, not another business report. Implement reusable request-scoped read snapshot abstraction and optional snapshot provider contract. Relational runtime uses existing IErpDbContext.Database with read-only Serializable transaction and 30-second operation deadline, no database configuration or SnapshotIsolation enabling. If transaction consistency cannot be provided, return environment/unsupported error; no unannounced fall back to unprotected multi-page reads. Only existing sales-order/receivable adapters are engine fixtures: apply fresh menu/column/customer scope and normalized predicates first, then native ordered Take(1001) identity probe and fail closed above 1000 matching facts. Do not COUNT/scan/materialize unbounded matches before applying source probe. Retrieve bounded IDs and related evidence in batches under same snapshot, reuse existing validated receivable calculation/context loader and fact grain; avoid N+1 and one-to-many multiplication. Stable source sorting and fact identity apply; internal snapshot <=1000 facts/8MiB, displayed preview <=200 rows/32 columns/1MiB. Never persist/cache snapshot across requests/users, never expose hidden dependencies. Normal preview display remains selected page with explicit matched count/coverage metadata and no all-match aggregate until next engine increment; reject premature all-match-total/pivot-total requests. Add optional query methods with default unsupported interface implementation so old providers/test doubles keep compiling; finite existing requests retain prior behavior. Thread cancellation through touched evidence loads/count probes and transaction dispose, record correlation/coverage/outcome without private values. Complete transaction before final fresh grant/menu/scope recheck and response; changes to authorized scope/grant deny whole response. Off-line fake snapshot lifecycle and EF query fixtures verify 1000/1001, mutations between reads, paging/grain/cancellation/final revocation; absent SQL Server/browser is explicitly environment-blocked. Stage 1 unified platform only; existing sales-order/receivable adapters are engine fixtures, not migration or new bespoke reports. Preserve old report entries until every fixed/dynamic report passes Stage 2 parity. No Agent or cross-business flow work. Server-authenticated identity and fresh existing menu/field/row/data scope remain authoritative, saved definitions/grants never grant ERP permissions. No arbitrary SQL, scripts, joins, tables, mixed currency/unit totals or one-to-many header duplication. No migrations, SchemaUpgrader/SeedData modifications, production SQL/database execution, schema/view/procedure changes, secrets/.env/config changes, deployment or irreversible operations. Use existing HTTP and entity audit conventions. Safe build/test and relevant offline integration tests required; missing actual DB/browser/font environment must be explicitly blocked, never claim the phase complete from build. Preserve unrelated source/work.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot abstraction and optional fixture contracts enforce read-only consistent bounded reads, transaction lifecycle and fresh authorization without changing existing endpoint behavior.
Native scoped 1001-identity probes fail above1000 before materialization; bounded batch evidence preserves source grain/order/null semantics and snapshot bytes/deadline limits.

Customer matched-set preview exposes selected page plus honest coverage/count, final revocation fails closed, offline boundary/lifecycle tests and safe build/test pass; real DB unavailable is blocked.
